action-confirmation-auditor.name: Action Confirmation Auditor
action-confirmation-auditor.description: Validates that Copilot Studio agent topics include user confirmation steps before executing actions (connector calls, cloud flows, plugins, HTTP requests), with zone-based policy enforcement for financial services governance.

prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin tenant role and Dataverse environment with the fsi publisher prefix.

action-confirmation-auditor.verification: Confirm Test-ActionConfirmationCompliance.ps1 writes rows to `fsi_actionscanrun` and `fsi_actionauditresult`.

agent-365-lifecycle-governance.name: Agent 365 Lifecycle Governance
agent-365-lifecycle-governance.description: Automated Agent 365 lifecycle governance for sponsor assignment, reviews, inactivity, deactivation, and deletion holds.

prerequisites.m365-admin: Microsoft 365/Agent 365 licensing and admin-center governance for sponsor and lifecycle workflows.
prerequisites.security-admin: Entra ID Governance P2, app permissions, security groups, and admin consent.
prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Managed Dataverse environment, Power Automate Premium, and LTR-enabled schema deployment.

agent-365-lifecycle-governance.verification: Confirm Test-LifecycleCompliance.ps1 completes and writes a lifecycle compliance event row.

agent-access-monitor.name: Agent Access Governance Monitor
agent-access-monitor.description: Automated validation of Power Platform environment agent access settings against zone-specific governance requirements.

prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin or Dynamics 365 Service Admin for tenant queries, baseline capture, and Dataverse schema setup.
prerequisites.m365-admin: Global Admin is the fallback for tenant-level setup when Power Platform admin access is unavailable.

agent-access-monitor.verification: Run Test-AgentAccessCompliance.ps1 and confirm rows are written to fsi_accessvalidationhistory and fsi_accessviolations.

agent-communication-restriction-detector.name: Agent Communication Restriction Detector
agent-communication-restriction-detector.description: Detects unauthorized agent-to-agent communication patterns, zone boundary violations, cross-tenant communication, and maker/checker violations in Copilot Studio multi-agent orchestration.

prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin tenant role and Dataverse environment with the fsi publisher prefix.

agent-communication-restriction-detector.verification: Confirm Test-CommRestrictionCompliance.ps1 writes rows to `fsi_CommScanRun` and `fsi_AgentCommViolation`.

agent-knowledge-source-scanner.name: Agent Knowledge Source Scanner
agent-knowledge-source-scanner.description: Item-level permission scanning for SharePoint libraries connected to Copilot Studio agents as knowledge sources.

prerequisites.sharepoint-admin: SharePoint Site Collection Admin or Site Member access is required to read item permissions in each target knowledge source library.
prerequisites.global-reader: Entra ID Reader or GroupMember.Read.All is required when resolving agent user scope from -AgentUserGroupId.

agent-knowledge-source-scanner.verification: Run Get-KnowledgeSourceItemPermissions.ps1 and confirm RiskScore values in ./output/item-permissions-report.csv, then cross-check any flagged items in SharePoint Manage Access.

agent-observability-foundation.name: Agent Observability Foundation
agent-observability-foundation.description: FSI-compliant telemetry infrastructure for Microsoft Copilot Studio agents with long-term audit retention, operational workbooks, and proactive alerting.

prerequisites.log-analytics-reader: Reader access to the Log Analytics workspace and Application Insights for queries and validation.
prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin tenant role for Copilot Studio telemetry source configuration.
prerequisites.m365-admin: Azure subscription Contributor/User Access Admin scoped to the resource group for deployment and resource creation.

agent-observability-foundation.verification: Confirm Application Insights customEvents and Log Analytics rows arrive within 24h and workbooks/alerts render without errors.

agent-registry-automation.name: Agent Registry Automation
agent-registry-automation.description: Automated discovery, registration, approval, and lifecycle governance of AI agents across Power Platform.

prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin for environment enumeration, Dataverse deployment, and flow creation.
prerequisites.security-admin: Entra Global Admin/Application Administrator for app registration, admin consent, and Graph permissions.
prerequisites.m365-admin: Microsoft 365 admin for Teams notifications and owner-status lookups.

agent-registry-automation.verification: Confirm Test-AgentRegistryCompliance.ps1 succeeds and the inventory pipeline records a new compliance event.

agent-sharing-access-restriction-detecto.name: Agent Sharing Access Restriction Detector
agent-sharing-access-restriction-detecto.description: Detects and remediates agent sharing configurations that violate zone-based security group policies.

prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin or Entra Global Admin for BAP Admin API access, Dataverse setup, and remediation flows.
prerequisites.m365-admin: Teams administrator or delegated permissions for adaptive card delivery and notification posting.

agent-sharing-access-restriction-detecto.verification: Confirm fsi_agentsharingcompliances and fsi_approvedsecuritygrouppolicies are populated after a sharing scan and remediation test.

audit-compliance-manager.name: Audit Compliance Manager
audit-compliance-manager.description: Unified audit compliance solution for Microsoft 365 and Power Platform environments. Consolidates the ACV and ALCA capabilities into one solution that validates audit configurations, detects gaps, and remediates non-compliant environments.

prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin tenant role and Dataverse System Administrator access in the target environment with the fsi publisher prefix.
prerequisites.compliance-admin: Microsoft Purview Compliance Administrator for audit log review, retention policy checks, and evidence export.

audit-compliance-manager.verification: Verify rows land in AuditValidationHistory and EnvironmentRegistry in Dataverse after a validation run, and confirm the audit dashboard reflects the latest tenant or environment status.

coi-testing.name: Conflict of Interest Testing
coi-testing.description: Automated conflict-of-interest testing for AI agent recommendations in financial services.

prerequisites.security-admin: Entra app registration and admin consent for Dataverse API access.
prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform/Dataverse admin for the fsi_coitestresults table, flow setup, and scheduled runner deployment.

coi-testing.verification: Confirm run_coi_tests.py writes a row to fsi_coitestresults when executed with --allow-skipped.

compliance-dashboard.name: Compliance Dashboard
compliance-dashboard.description: Aggregated compliance reporting dashboard for the FSI Agent Governance Framework with zone-based filtering and Dataverse-backed control records.

prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin tenant role and a Dataverse environment with the fsi publisher prefix.
prerequisites.compliance-admin: Microsoft Purview Compliance Administrator for compliance evidence review and export.
prerequisites.m365-admin: Power BI workspace owner or capacity admin with M365 E5 or E5 Compliance licensing for dashboard access.
prerequisites.global-reader: Read-only tenant visibility for configuration validation and troubleshooting.

compliance-dashboard.verification: Confirm fsi_controlmasters contains the 78-control baseline, then open the Power BI dashboard and verify the latest Dataverse-synced tiles refresh successfully.

conditional-access-automation.name: Conditional Access Automation
conditional-access-automation.description: Automated deployment and compliance monitoring of Entra ID Conditional Access policies for Microsoft 365 AI workloads (Copilot Studio, Agent Builder, M365 Copilot).

prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin tenant role for Dataverse environment and solution setup.
prerequisites.security-admin: Conditional Access Administrator or Security Administrator for policy creation and review.
prerequisites.m365-admin: Application Administrator for service principal registration and Graph permission consent.
prerequisites.global-reader: Global Reader for read-only audit and report validation.

conditional-access-automation.verification: Confirm the compliance scan populates fsi_capolicyvalidationhistories and fsi_capolicyviolations, with active baselines in fsi_capolicybaselines.

content-moderation-monitor.name: Content Moderation Monitor
content-moderation-monitor.description: Automated validation of Copilot Studio agent content moderation levels against zone-specific governance requirements.

prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin, Dynamics 365 Service Admin, or Global Admin to enumerate environments and read bot records; Dataverse access requires System Administrator or System Customizer in each target environment.

content-moderation-monitor.verification: Run Test-ContentModerationCompliance.ps1 -ExcludeSandbox and confirm new rows in fsi_moderationvalidationhistory and fsi_moderationviolations with a matching fsi_validationtime and fsi_runid.

copilot-studio-analytics.name: Copilot Studio Analytics
copilot-studio-analytics.description: Business impact analytics for Copilot Studio agents—session outcomes, CSAT, Agent Assisted Hours, and ROI tracking. Extends Agent Observability Foundation with zone-based governance; not a full Viva Insights replacement.

prerequisites.log-analytics-reader: Reader access to the Agent Observability workspace and Application Insights from Agent Observability Foundation.
prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin tenant role for Dataverse, Copilot Studio configuration, and solution deployment.

copilot-studio-analytics.verification: Run the Dataverse session sync and confirm CopilotSessionOutcome events and workbook queries return data.

credential-oversharing-detector.name: Credential Oversharing Detector
credential-oversharing-detector.description: Scans Copilot Studio agent credentials against zone policy to detect overprivileged connectors, excessive OAuth scopes, unauthorized service accounts, cross-environment sharing, and stale credentials.

prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin tenant role and Dataverse environment with the fsi publisher prefix.

credential-oversharing-detector.verification: Confirm Invoke-CredentialScan.ps1 writes rows to `fsi_credentialscans` and `fsi_credentialviolations`.

cross-solution-integration.name: Cross-Solution Integration
cross-solution-integration.description: Integration layer that connects the Tier 2 governance solutions into the Compliance Dashboard and Environment Lifecycle Management workflow.

prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin tenant role for Dataverse tables, Power Automate flows, and solution imports.
prerequisites.m365-admin: Power BI workspace owner or dashboard admin for the Compliance Dashboard integration.
prerequisites.global-reader: Read-only visibility for source-solution and tenant configuration checks during sync validation.

cross-solution-integration.verification: Run Sync-SolutionAssessments.ps1 and confirm rows are written or updated in fsi_controlassessments for the expected control IDs, with the Power Automate feed collector completing successfully.

cross-tenant-external-sharing-governance.name: Cross-Tenant External Sharing Governance
cross-tenant-external-sharing-governance.description: Automated detection, validation, and remediation of cross-tenant access for Power Platform AI agents in FSI environments.

prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin for tenant isolation settings, PPAC access, and Dataverse setup.
prerequisites.m365-admin: Entra Global Admin or Cross-Tenant Access Administrator for Graph consent and partner policy changes.
prerequisites.compliance-admin: Optional compliance/audit reviewer for the Dataverse compliance event log and retention checks.

cross-tenant-external-sharing-governance.verification: Confirm fsi_crosstenantcomplianceevent receives events and fsi_approvedexternaltenant is updated during onboarding and remediation runs.

deny-event-correlation-report.name: Deny Event Correlation Report
deny-event-correlation-report.description: Daily reporting for correlating deny/no-content events across Copilot and Copilot Studio using Purview, Application Insights, and optional Defender data.

prerequisites.compliance-admin: Purview Compliance Admin/View-Only Audit Logs for audit log extraction and CSV exports.
prerequisites.log-analytics-reader: Monitoring Reader on Application Insights for RAI telemetry correlation.
prerequisites.m365-admin: Azure subscription access for Storage, Automation, and scheduled runbook deployment.

deny-event-correlation-report.verification: Confirm the daily runbook produces CSV exports and current-day audit/RAI correlations without errors.

dr-testing-framework.name: DR Testing Framework
dr-testing-framework.description: Post-recovery validation and evidence packaging for Power Platform DR testing.

prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin for PPAC restore operations and managed target environment access.
prerequisites.security-admin: Entra app registration/admin consent and Dataverse system administrator access for evidence writes.

dr-testing-framework.verification: Confirm Invoke-DRTest.ps1 inserts a fsi_drtestresult row and Export-DREvidence.ps1 packages the evidence.

environment-lifecycle-management.name: Environment Lifecycle Management
environment-lifecycle-management.description: Automated Power Platform environment provisioning with zone-based governance.

prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin for environment creation, environment groups, and managed environment provisioning.
prerequisites.security-admin: Entra Global Admin/Application Administrator for app registration, admin consent, and Dataverse schema setup.
prerequisites.m365-admin: Microsoft 365 admin for cross-service notifications and governance operations.

environment-lifecycle-management.verification: Confirm a request provisions a managed environment and writes a provisioning log row to Dataverse.

file-upload-security.name: File Upload Security
file-upload-security.description: Automated validation of Copilot Studio agent file upload settings against governance zone policies. Supports Control 1.14 by detecting agents with file uploads enabled where uploads should be restricted or disabled.

prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin, Dynamics 365 Service Admin, or Global Admin to enumerate environments and write Dataverse baseline and violation records.

file-upload-security.verification: Run Test-FileUploadCompliance.ps1 and confirm new rows in fsi_fileuploadvalidationhistory and fsi_fileuploadviolation, with the latest fsi_runtimestamp reflecting the scan.

finra-supervision-workflow.name: FINRA Supervision Workflow
finra-supervision-workflow.description: Automated retrospective supervision workflow for AI agent outputs to support FINRA Rule 3110 compliance in financial services organizations. This solution provides a post-delivery review queue, SLA tracking, escalation, and immutable audit logging fed by Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance.

prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin tenant role and Dataverse table creation access for the supervision queue and log schema.
prerequisites.compliance-admin: Microsoft Purview Compliance Administrator for Communication Compliance policy access and alert review.
prerequisites.security-admin: Entra Application Administrator or equivalent for service principal registration and consent.

finra-supervision-workflow.verification: Create a test queue item and confirm rows appear in fsi_supervisionqueue and fsi_supervisionlog, then verify the Power BI supervision report shows the new item.

generative-ai-config-auditor.name: Generative AI Config Auditor
generative-ai-config-auditor.description: Validates generative AI feature configurations (Azure OpenAI integration, generative orchestration, generative answers nodes, knowledge sources, Model Knowledge toggle, Semantic Search toggle) for Copilot Studio agents against zone-specific governance policies.

prerequisites.power-platform-admin: Power Platform admin tenant role and Dataverse environment with the fsi publisher prefix.

generative-ai-config-auditor.verification: Confirm Test-GenAIConfigCompliance.ps1 writes rows to `fsi_GACValidationHistory` and `fsi_GACViolation`.

hallucination-tracker.name: Hallucination Feedback Tracker
hallucination-tracker.description: Feedback aggregation pipeline for tracking and analyzing hallucination patterns in AI agent outputs.

prerequisites.global-reader: Read-only Dataverse access for the analysis script's Basic User-style queries.
prerequisites.m365-admin: Power BI workspace/admin setup for dashboard publishing and service access.

hallucination-tracker.verification: Run pattern analysis and verify the scorecard and query outputs populate for recent feedback records.

hitl-workflow-governance.name: HITL Workflow Governance

inactivity-timeout-enforcement.name: Inactivity Timeout Enforcement
inactivity-timeout-enforcement.description: Cloud Flow template for daily compliance detection of inactivity timeout settings across Power Platform environments.

message-center-monitor.name: Message Center Monitor
message-center-monitor.description: Monitor Microsoft 365 Message Center for platform changes affecting AI agents.
